# disk-usage-mcp

## Overview

FastMCP server wrapping dua-cli and czkawka_cli for disk usage analysis and duplicate detection. Designed for multi-TB media libraries spread across multiple drives.

## Dependencies

- Python 3.12+
- [dua-cli](https://github.com/Byron/dua-cli) — `winget install Byron.dua-cli`
- [czkawka_cli](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka) — `winget install qarmin.czkawka`
- FastMCP 3.4+
- FastAPI + uvicorn

## Architecture

```
dua-cli ──→ disk-usage-mcp ──→ FastAPI REST ──→ React/Vite frontend
czkawka_cli ──→   (MCP protocol)    ├── /api/health
                                       ├── /api/scan
                                       ├── /api/snapshot/take
                                       ├── /api/snapshots
                                       └── /api/v1/diagnostics
```

## MCP Tools

### scan_path_tool
```
scan_path_tool(path="D:\\Media", max_depth=3)
→ {"success": true, "data": {"name": "D:", "size": ..., "children": [...]}}
```

### find_large_files_tool
```
find_large_files_tool(path="D:\\", min_size_gb=5.0)
→ {"success": true, "files": [{"path": "...", "size_gb": 5.2}]}
```

### get_drive_overview_tool
```
get_drive_overview_tool(paths=["C:\\", "D:\\", "E:\\", "F:\\"])
→ {"success": true, "drives": [...], "total_bytes": ...}
```

### find_duplicates_tool
```
find_duplicates_tool(search_paths=["D:\\", "E:\\"], min_size_mb=100)
→ {"success": true, "duplicates": [{"hash": "...", "size_mb": 500, "files": [...]}]}
```

## Best Practices

1. Start with `get_drive_overview_tool` to see drive-level allocation
2. Drill into specific drives with `scan_path_tool` at depth 2-3
3. Use `find_large_files_tool` with min_size_gb=10+ for quick space recovery
4. Run `find_duplicates_tool` across backup drives last (slowest operation)

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| BACKEND_PORT | 11114 | REST API port |
| FRONTEND_PORT | 11115 | Vite dev port |
| MCP_PORT | 11114 | MCP HTTP port |
| DUA_BIN | dua | Path to dua binary |
| CZKAWKA_BIN | czkawka_cli | Path to czkawka binary |

## Ports

- Backend (FastAPI): 11114
- Frontend (Vite dev): 11115
